title: Site cursor (decoded)
description: page.cursor / nextCursor is base64url (no padding) of this JSON. It is a documented keyset, not an opaque token, so the Control Plane can mint a site cursor from the last item it consumed when merging several sites. k = [evaluatedAt, edgeAssessmentId] of the last item returned; the next page holds items strictly after k in (evaluatedAt desc, edgeAssessmentId desc) order. q = SHA-256 hex of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the op params; the Edge rejects a cursor whose q differs from the request's (INVALID_CURSOR).
